1-s100.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 100. Встреча с писателем Аланом Дюрантом. 1) Какие вопросы задали дети? 2) Сколько книг он написал? 3) Проверь по правилу.
steps: 1) What other books have you written? Have you ever written fairy tales?
2–3) He has written over seventy books: picture books, novels, football stories, fairy tales and poetry for children. Present Perfect — результат к настоящему моменту.
1-s100.answer: Более 70 книг; Have you ever …? — Present Perfect

2-s101.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 101. Соотнеси вопросы Клэр и Пола с ответами французских друзей.
steps: Have you watched «Ice Age»? — Yes, I have. I have watched it twice.
Have you ever travelled to Scotland? — No, I haven't.
Have you ever eaten fish and chips? — Yes, I have. I ate it yesterday.
Have you ever been to the Tower? — Yes, we have.
2-s101.answer: Have you ever …? — Yes, I have / No, I haven't

3-s101.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 101. Разыграй диалог с Дэниелом о своём опыте.
steps: — Have you ever heard English songs? — Yes, I have. They are nice.
— Have you ever flown a kite? — No, I haven't.
— Have you ever been to London? — No, but I'd like to go there.

4-s102.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 102. Разыграй диалог Мари и Люка о том, что они сделали.
steps: — Have you ever been to a foreign country? — Yes, I have. I have been to England. — When did you go there? — Last year. — What did you see? — I saw Big Ben and the Tower.
Обрати внимание: общий опыт — Present Perfect, конкретное время — Past Simple.
4-s102.answer: Have you ever been …? — Yes. When did you go? — Last year

5-s102.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 102. AB 1.1–1.3 (с. 78): дополни предложения третьей и второй формой глаголов.
steps: AB 1.1–1.2: seen; seen; heard; heard; been; eaten; danced.
AB 1.3: found; drew; ate; saw; spent; caught; performed.
5-s102.answer: V3: seen, heard, been, eaten, danced; V2: found, drew, ate, saw, spent, caught, performed

6-s102.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 6, с. 102. Что полезного, увлекательного, важного ты сделал(а) в этом году?
steps: I've learnt to ride a scooter. I've already read three books. I haven't had a Maths test yet, but I'd like to get a good mark. I've visited a new museum. I've made new friends.

7-s102.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 3, упр. 7, с. 102. AB 2 (с. 79): рассказ ребят о лучшем за год — поставь глаголы в нужную форму. AB 11 (с. 126): лучшее, чему ты научился(ась).
steps: AB 2: am; have won; lost; didn't talk; cried; have learnt; win; have learnt; have learnt; has taught; has been; have made.
AB 11: The best thing I've learnt this year is how to bake pancakes. I couldn't make them tasty, but now I can. My granny has taught me.
7-s102.answer: Present Perfect / Past Simple в рассказе; своё достижение

1-s103.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 103. 1) Понравилась ли Мари поездка? 2) Что Мари и Клэр говорили о Йорке и какие времена использовали? 3) Прочитай правило. AB 1: соотнеси глаголы.
steps: 1) Marie liked the trip very much.
2) Clare: But I have read about its history (Present Perfect). Marie: We were in York yesterday. It was great (Past Simple). While we were walking, we saw the Minster (Past Progressive).
3) Для описания событий в прошлом используют три формы: Past Simple, Past Progressive, Present Perfect.
AB 1: E, F, F, A, B, C, C.
1-s103.answer: Три прошедших формы; E, F, F, A, B, C, C

2-s105.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 105. Дополни разговор предложениями из рамки.
steps: Clare: Why don't we go to Hampton Court Palace? — Marie: I'd love to. Have you been there? — Clare: Yes, I have. I went there last year. It was great. — Marie: What did you see? — Clare: The maze and the gardens.
2-s105.answer: Why don't we …? I'd love to. Have you been there? — Yes, I went there last year

3-s105.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 105. Раскрой скобки, поставив глаголы в подходящее время.
steps: Clare: «Hansel and Gretel» is on at the Unicorn Theatre. Would you like to see the play? — Marie: Yes! I have never seen it. — Clare: I saw it last year. It was wonderful. — Marie: What were the actors doing when …?
Глаголы: is, have never seen, saw, was, were doing.
3-s105.answer: have never seen, saw, was, were doing

4-s105.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 105. Reader 2: письмо мальчика с грамматической ошибкой.
steps: 2.1: The boy keeps writing «I have went» — the correct Present Perfect form is «I have gone».
2.2: The boy didn't get rid of the mistake. He couldn't remember the V3 form of «go».
2.3: Past Simple (V2): came, ate, took, went, spent, sang, wore, wrote, saw, did. Present Perfect (have + V3): written, gone, seen, done, eaten.
2.4: Past Simple: wrote, was, said, came back, saw. Past Progressive: was writing. Present Perfect: have gone, have written.
4-s105.answer: Ошибка have went → have gone; формы V2 и V3

5-s105.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 4, упр. 5, с. 105. AB 2 (с. 80): раскрой скобки. Reader 3: дневник Каролины о гонке.
steps: AB 2: have already done; wrote; will you perform; started; will show.

Reader 3.1: C — a boat race. 3.2: Land's End; Irish; Fastnet Rock; Scilly Isles; Plymouth. 3.3: действия в прошлом с указанием времени — Past Simple; результат — Present Perfect; длительные — Past Progressive.
5-s105.answer: have already done, wrote, will you perform, started, will show; гонка на лодках

r4-s105.condition: Unit 6, Reading lesson, с. 105. Reader 4: письмо, статья и дневник о событиях в Англии.
steps: 4.1: Text 1 is a letter, text 2 is a newspaper article, text 3 is a diary.
4.2: Oliver wrote about a street performance (a). Bill wrote about a competition (b). Clare wrote about an official ceremony (c).
4.3: Windsor — a town in England; «Kyla» — the name of a boat; Cowes — a port.
4.4: F, F, T, T, F, T, T, T, T, T.
4.5: August 7; Cowes; in this class; 6 days; Land's End; the Fastnet Rock; the Scilly Isles; Kyla was the second.
4.6: Oliver — went, were; Clare — were, saw; Bill — took part, won; Caroline — sailed, arrived.
4.7: Oliver: Caroline, have you ever taken part in a boat race? — Caroline: Yes, I have. It was great! Clare, did you see the Queen? — Clare: Yes, I did.
4.8: My favourite trip was to St Petersburg. I enjoyed the city walks and sightseeing. Best of all I liked the Hermitage.
r4-s105.answer: Типы текстов; F, F, T, T, F, T, T, T, T, T; исправления репортажа

1-s106.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 106. 1) Послушай: в каких странах побывал Марк? 2) Ответь на вопросы по диалогу.
steps: 1) Mark has been to Spain, Italy, Australia and America.
2) Daniel asks: Have you travelled a lot? What places? Where were you in America? Which place did you like best? Mark: I've been to New York. I liked Disneyland best.
1-s106.answer: Испания, Италия, Австралия, Америка; вопросы и ответы

2-s107.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 107. 1) Соотнеси реплики в два диалога Пола и Люка. 2) Дополни разговор.
steps: 1) Dialogue 1: Paul: Where were you today? — Luke: We had an excursion to Hampton Court. — Paul: Did you like it? — Luke: Yes, it was great. Dialogue 2: Paul: Have you ever been to the Tower? — Luke: No, I haven't. — Paul: Let's go tomorrow!
2) Did you visit …? Have you ever been there? What did you like there? What did you do after lessons? Have you been to …?
2-s107.answer: Два диалога об экскурсиях; вопросы Did / Have you ever / What

3-s108.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 108. Обменяйся с иностранным другом информацией о любимых экскурсиях.
steps: Pupil 1: Have you been to any exhibition this year? — Pupil 2: Yes, I have. I have been to an art exhibition. — Pupil 1: When did you go there? — Pupil 2: In March. — Pupil 1: What did you see? — Pupil 2: Pictures by Russian artists.
3-s108.answer: Have you been …? When did you go? What did you see?

4-s108.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 108. Расскажи об экскурсии, которую ты посетил(а) в этом году.
steps: This year I was on an excursion to the Planetarium. We went there with the class. It was very exciting! We saw the stars and planets and watched a film about space. I have never seen anything like that before.
4-s108.answer: Рассказ об экскурсии: где, с кем, что видел

5-s108.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 108. AB 1 (с. 81): выбери верные ответы или вопросы. AB 12 (с. 126): школьная экскурсия, которая понравилась больше всех.
steps: AB 1: C, A, C, C, A, B.
AB 12: This school year we were at the zoo in Moscow. It was interesting because there were a lot of different animals. We saw elephants and giraffes. We had a great time.
5-s108.answer: C, A, C, C, A, B; рассказ об экскурсии

ab1-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 1 (с. 82). Дополни предложения верной формой глагола и укажи номер правила.
steps: have seen — 3; have never travelled — 3; travelled — 1; were — 1; were you doing — 2; was watching — 2; has been — 3; went — 1.
ab1-s108.answer: 1 — Past Simple, 2 — Past Progressive, 3 — Present Perfect

ab2-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 2.1–2.2 (с. 83). 1) Распредели формы по колонкам Past Simple / Present Perfect. 2) Дополни письмо глаголами.
steps: 2.1: Past Simple: knew, won, took, swam, came, was, wrote, got, ran, spoke, ate, bought, rode. Present Perfect: known, won, taken, swum, come, been, written, got, run, spoken, eaten, bought, ridden.
2.2: has found; went; has learnt; has taken; was; won; have written; haven't heard.
ab2-s108.answer: V2 / V3; has found, went, has learnt, has taken, was, won, have written, haven't heard

ab3-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 3 (с. 84). Прочитай письмо Хелен и напиши о её каникулах.
steps: On the third of July Helen and her friends were in the sports camp. They had a great time there. The weather was fine. They swam, played volleyball and went on excursions. Helen has made new friends.
ab3-s108.answer: Рассказ о каникулах Хелен в третьем лице

ab4-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 4 (с. 84). Дополни текст верными формами глаголов.
steps: didn't go; went; spent; was living; worked; helped; was; came back.
ab4-s108.answer: didn't go, went, spent, was living, worked, helped, was, came back

ab5-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 5 (с. 85). Прочитай пункты 1–6 и расскажи о себе.
steps: I went to the park last Sunday too. But I went to school on Friday. I wasn't watching a film from 5 to 7 p.m. yesterday — I was doing my homework. I have never been to London. I have read two books this month.
ab5-s108.answer: Предложения о себе в трёх прошедших формах

ab6-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 6 (с. 85). По расписанию Пола скажи, что он делал и не делал.
steps: Paul didn't visit Peter on Monday. Tom has been to the library this week — he was there on Tuesday. He was taking photos at 5 p.m. on Wednesday. He hasn't played football yet.
ab6-s108.answer: didn't …, has been …, was taking …, hasn't … yet

ab7-s108.condition: Unit 6, Consolidation, AB 7 (с. 86). Исправь 7 ошибок в диалоге.
steps: Have you already been to the shop? — Yes, I have. Have you bought everything? — Yes, I have. And what were you doing at 3 o'clock? — I was walking in the park. Did you see Ann? — Yes, I saw her yesterday.
ab7-s108.answer: have been, have bought, were you doing, was walking, did you see, saw

1-s109.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 6, упр. 1, с. 109. Напиши проект: 1) поездка, которая понравилась больше всего; 2) школьный день; 3) лучшее за год.
steps: 1) I would like to tell you about my trip to Peterhof. We went there on holiday. We were walking in the park when the fountains started. It was fantastic!
2) I would like to tell you about a school day in the 2nd form. It was a spring festival and an open day. We were singing and dancing.
3) There were a lot of amazing things last year. First, I have learnt to swim. Second, I have visited Kazan.
1-s109.answer: Проект с Past Simple / Progressive / Present Perfect

2-s109.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 6, упр. 2, с. 109. Защити проект и ответь на вопросы одноклассников.
steps: Убедимся, что понимаем каждое слово в проекте. Отрепетируем. Отвечаем: When did you go there? — Last summer. Have you been there again? — No, not yet.

3-s109.condition: Unit 6, Lesson 6, упр. 3, с. 109. Обсудите проекты и выберите лучший.
steps: Personally I feel that Masha's project is the best because it is creative, detailed and illustrated. It seems to me that Dima's project is interesting too.
3-s109.answer: I feel that …'s project is the best because …

i-s110.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself I, с. 110 (AB с. 86). Послушай запись и определи, какие факты верны.
steps: T, F, T, T, F, F.
i-s110.answer: T, F, T, T, F, F

ii-s110.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself II, с. 110 (AB с. 87–88). 1) Расставь абзацы по порядку. 2) True / False. 3) Выпиши по одному глаголу каждого времени.
steps: II.1: A, C, B, E, D.
II.2: True, False, False, True, True.
II.3: Past Simple — took; Past Progressive — were driving; Present Perfect — have found.
ii-s110.answer: A, C, B, E, D; T, F, F, T, T; took / were driving / have found

iii-s110.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself III, с. 110 (AB с. 88). 1) Поставь глаголы в правильную форму. 2) Вставь предлоги.
steps: III.1: was (действие закончилось); was riding (длилось в момент прошлого); have visited (результат); saw; were playing; has never been.
III.2: to; when; from; to; for; while; of; during; at; at.
iii-s110.answer: was, was riding, have visited, saw, were playing, has never been; to, when, from, to, for, while, of, during, at, at

iv-s110.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself IV, с. 110. 1) Составь диалог по условиям. 2) Расскажи об экскурсии иностранному другу.
steps: 1) Pupil 1: Have you ever visited the Natural History Museum? — Pupil 2: No, I have never been there. What about you? — Pupil 1: I went there last year. It was great. — Pupil 2: What did you see? — Pupil 1: Dinosaurs!
2) I went on an excursion to the planetarium last week. We watched a programme about the universe. It was amazing. I have never seen so many stars.

v-s111.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself V, с. 111. Соотнеси названия музеев и информацию, которую в них можно узнать.
v-s111.answer: C, E, B, G, F, D, A

vi-s112.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself VI, с. 112. Напиши письмо (70 слов) иностранному другу о школьной экскурсии.
steps: Dear John, how are you? I am writing to tell you about my school trip. This term I have been to Moscow. We were walking around Red Square and visited the Kremlin. While we were looking at the Tsar Bell, our guide told us its history. We also went to the Zoo. It was a great trip. Have you ever been to Moscow? Best wishes, Alex.

vii-s112.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself VII, с. 112. Проверь, как усвоены слова раздела.
steps: a ceremony — церемония; a queen — королева; a sight — достопримечательность; an attraction — аттракцион; an excursion — экскурсия; a trip — поездка; a voyage — путешествие по морю; to take part — участвовать; to enjoy — наслаждаться.

viii-s112.condition: Unit 6, Test yourself VIII, с. 112 (AB IV, с. 89). Оцени навыки, приобретённые в разделе.
steps: Я могу читать и понимать детские впечатления о поездках — 5. Могу рассказать о своей поездке — 4. Могу задавать вопросы Have you ever …? — 5. Различаю Past Simple / Past Progressive / Present Perfect — 4.

1-s114.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 1, с. 114. Уэллеры планируют поездку в Британию. 1) Что они делают в первый день и через день? 2) Найди предложения о будущем. 3) Что запланировано? 4) Прочитай правило.
steps: 1) On the first day the Wellers are touring London. In a day they are visiting the Highlands.
2) We are going to Britain in ten days! How long are we staying here? On the first day we are touring London. In a day we are visiting the Highlands.
3) are going; are we staying; are touring; are visiting — Present Progressive для запланированного будущего.
4) Present Progressive используется для заранее спланированных действий в будущем.
1-s114.answer: Present Progressive для планов: are going, are staying, are touring, are visiting

2-s114.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 2, с. 114. Соотнеси предложения.
steps: Fred has bought a ticket to Washington — he is going to the USA soon. Pam has read a guide about Edinburgh — she is visiting Scotland. Tom has packed his suitcase — he is leaving tomorrow. Ann has bought a swimsuit — she is going to the seaside.

3-s115.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 3, с. 115. AB 1 (с. 91): какие предложения о настоящем (Pr), а какие о будущем (F)?
steps: Pr, F; Pr, F; Pr, F; F, Pr.

4-s115.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 4, с. 115. Соотнеси фрагменты и составь предложения о Уэллерах.
steps: Amy is buying souvenirs. The Wellers are visiting their friends in London. William is studying the map. Mrs Weller is packing the suitcases. Mr Weller is booking the tickets.

5-s116.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 5, с. 116. Дополни план поездки.
steps: We are visiting the theatre at 7 p.m. on Sunday. We are touring Edinburgh on Monday. We are arriving at Alloway on Tuesday. We are visiting the Burns Museum on Wednesday. We are leaving for London on Thursday.

6-s116.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 1, упр. 6, с. 116. 1) Стюарт и Рой планируют неделю — по календарю составь диалоги. 2) Что ты делаешь в субботу и воскресенье? 3) Напиши e-mail другу о планах на неделю.
steps: 1) — Stuart, why don't we go to the cinema on Friday? — I'm sorry, I can't. I am going to the swimming pool on Friday. What about Saturday? — OK, on Saturday I'm free.
2) On Saturday morning I am going to school. After school I am taking part in a competition. On Saturday evening I am visiting my granny. On Sunday I am playing football.

3) Hi, Tom! Next week will be busy. On Monday I am going to the swimming pool. On Tuesday and Wednesday I am having music lessons. On Friday I am visiting my grandparents. What are you doing next week? Alex.

1-s117.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 1, с. 117. 1) Что миссис Аткинсон собирается сделать? 2) Что собираются делать Пол и миссис Аткинсон?
steps: 1) Mrs Atkinson is going to send her children to their grandparents.
2) Mrs Atkinson is going to send her children to the grandparents. Paul is going to ride horses.

2-s117.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 2, с. 117. Что Аткинсоны собираются делать во время путешествия на лодке?
steps: Peter Atkinson is going to pilot the boat. The whole family is going to admire the wonderful landscapes and relax. Oliver is going to fish. Paul is going to take photos. Mrs Atkinson is going to cook.

3-s118.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 3, с. 118. Что дети собираются делать на каникулах?
steps: Sam is going to ride a bike. Phil is going to swim. Sally is going to go fishing. Ken and Dan are going to play football. Ann is going to read books.

4-s118.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 4, с. 118. Составь диалог: Пол обсуждает с другом планы на лето.
steps: Paul: What are you going to do during these holidays? — Friend: I am going to visit my grandparents. And you? — Paul: I'm going to ride horses in Devon. — Friend: Great! Are you going to swim in the sea? — Paul: Yes, I am.

5-s118.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 5, с. 118. AB 1 (с. 93): что Оливер и его друзья собираются делать на каникулах?
steps: He is going to collect leaves. She is going to sew doll's clothes. He is going to learn new magic tricks. She is going to read books. They are going to play tennis.

6-s118.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 2, упр. 6, с. 118. AB 2 (с. 94): вопросы о выходных. AB 13 (с. 126): планы на июнь, июль, август. Reader 1: рассказ Лизы о рыбалке.
steps: AB 2: What books is Liz going to read? What films is Liz going to watch? Are you going to see the Tower of London? Are they going to visit the zoo?
AB 13: In June I am going to visit my grandparents and help them. In July I am going to a summer camp. In August I am going to the seaside with my parents.

Reader 1.1: Lisa fishes in the lake. 1.2: A — Мой отец не берёт меня на рыбалку. B — Он говорит, что свежая рыба лучше, чем из магазина. 1.3: A. 1.4: настоящее — are doing, are boating, are fishing, are sitting; прошедшее — caught, took, said. 1.5: [æ] catch, black, daddy, back, champions; [ɑː] grandpa, father.
6-s118.answer: Вопросы с going to; планы на лето; Reader о рыбалке

1-s119.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 1, с. 119. Клэр и семья едут в Брайтон. 1) Что Лора не знает? 2) Что Клэр и Лора надеются делать и какие формы используют? 3) Что будут делать Клэр, Лора и семья?
steps: 1) Laura doesn't know what to say — she will ask her mum's permission first.
2) Laura hopes she will go with Clare. Clare thinks they will swim and sunbathe. Они используют will для предположений и надежд.
3) I think the whole family will tour the town because they like sunny days in Brighton. Clare and Laura will swim in the sea.
1-s119.answer: will — предположения: I think / I hope … will …

2-s120.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 2, с. 120. Первый визит Лоры в Брайтон — составь вопросы с Shall I …? и ответы.
steps: — Shall I take my favourite books? — I'm afraid you can't. — Shall I take a swimsuit? — Yes, of course! — Shall I take warm clothes? — I don't think so, it will be sunny. — Shall I take my camera? — Sure!
2-s120.answer: Shall I take …? — Yes, of course / I'm afraid you can't

3-s120.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 3, с. 120. Лора пригласила Клэр в зоопарк. Что Клэр будет делать? Что она сделает, если …?
steps: I think Clare will ask for some pocket money. She will take her camera. If it rains, she will take an umbrella. If she sees a giraffe, she will take a photo. I think she will buy an ice cream.
3-s120.answer: I think Clare will …; If …, she will …

4-s121.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 4, с. 121. 1) Игра «Сделай предсказание» с кубиками. 2) Обсуди предсказания с партнёром.
steps: 1) Бросаем кубики, выбираем идеи под выпавшими цифрами и формулируем: I think you will become a famous actor. You will travel to Australia.
2) I think I will get only good marks. — I don't think so. I think you will become a pilot. — Maybe!
4-s121.answer: Предсказания с will: I think … will …

5-s121.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 3, упр. 5, с. 121. AB 1.1–1.2 (с. 95): что Дугласы делают каждый день и что будут делать завтра; о себе. Reader 2: песенка о вечеринке. Reader 3: история о бабушкином саде.
steps: AB 1.1: Clare Douglas goes to school every day. Tomorrow she will go to school too. Mr Douglas goes to work. Tomorrow he will go to work. AB 1.2: Every day I read a lot. Tomorrow I will read a new book.
Reader 2.1: C — about a future party. 2.2: I'll bring my favourite dolls and films. We'll dance and play games.
Reader 3.1: She wanted to plant one apple tree every year. Extra — 2. 3.2: A — F, B — T, C — F, D — T, E — T. 3.3: [e] when, extra; [iː] see, seed, need; [ɪə] year, here.
5-s121.answer: Every day … / Tomorrow … will …; Reader: C; F, T, F, T, T

1-s122.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 1, с. 122. 1) Прочитай письмо: интересной ли будет поездка? 2) Найди в письме действия в будущем и определи формы.
steps: 1) I think their future trip will be interesting because they are going to Spain and they are visiting a lot of interesting places.

2) Present Progressive (am/is/are + V-ing) — для запланированных действий: we are flying on Monday. Be going to — для намерений: we are going to swim. Will — для предположений: I think it will be hot.

2-s124.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 2, с. 124. Дополни телефонный разговор Глории и Мелани репликами.
steps: B, D, A, F.

3-s124.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 3, с. 124. AB 1 (с. 96): дополни предложения 1–3 верными формами.
steps: My parents and I are going to visit our relatives in Wales. We are leaving on Saturday. I think it will be fun. We are going to see castles.
3-s124.answer: are going to visit, are leaving, will be, are going to see

4-s124.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 4, с. 124. Расскажи, что Аткинсоны будут делать на каникулах в Испании.
steps: Peter Atkinson and his sons are going to the Barcelona Football Club match. The parents and the children are visiting the Picasso Museum. Mrs Atkinson is going to go shopping. I think they will have a great time.
4-s124.answer: are going to / are visiting / will

5-s124.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 4, упр. 5, с. 124. AB 2 (с. 96): выбери подходящие варианты. Reader 4: Стюарт Литтл участвует в гонке.
steps: AB 2: is leaving; will go; are spending; will go.

Reader 4.1: Stuart Little wanted to take part in a boat race. 4.2: A — d, B — a, C — e, D — b, E — f. 4.3: Present Progressive: «You are taking part in the race on my ship». Be going to: «I'm going to win». Will: «It will be a great race».
5-s124.answer: is leaving, will go, are spending, will go; Reader: A-d, B-a, C-e, D-b, E-f

r5-s124.condition: Unit 7, Reading lesson, с. 124. Reader 5: Дженнингс хочет попасть в первую сборную по футболу.
steps: 5.1: Jennings wanted to get into the First Eleven very much.
5.2: They won one nil. You are running a temperature. Johnson scored the goal. But Jennings was so nervous that he couldn't play.
5.5: Намерения — Is our team going to play …? Планы — Our team is playing on Saturday. Предположения — I think we will win.
r5-s124.answer: A; B, A, B, B, B, A, A, A; going to / Progressive / will

1-s125.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 1, с. 125. 1) Куда едут ребята? 2) Какие вопросы задают?
steps: 1) To the USA.
2) How long are we staying on board the ship? What can we do on board? When are we arriving in New York?
1-s125.answer: В США на корабле; вопросы о путешествии

2-s125.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 2, с. 125. Найди и прочитай диалоги двух мальчиков о предстоящем круизе.
steps: Dialogue 1: A: We are going on a voyage. — B: I am happy to hear it. — A: Then we must buy tickets. — B: When are we leaving? — A: Next Friday.
Dialogue 2: A: How long are we staying on the ship? — B: For a week. — A: What are we going to do? — B: Swim in the pool and watch films.

3-s126.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 3, с. 126. Заполни пропуски в диалоге Клэр и Лоры.
steps: Laura: When are you going on a voyage? — Clare: I am going in a week. — Laura: Are you going with your brother? — Clare: Yes, I am. — Laura: What are you going to do on board? — Clare: We are going to swim and play games. — Laura: I think you will have a great time.
3-s126.answer: When are you going? Are you going with …? What are you going to do?

4-s126.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 4, с. 126. Составь и разыграй диалог по карточкам.
steps: A: Next month my parents and I are going to Brighton. — B: That's great! What are you planning to do there? — A: We are going to swim and visit the pier. — B: How long are you staying? — A: For two weeks. — B: I think you'll enjoy it!

5-s126.condition: Unit 7, Lesson 5, упр. 5, с. 126. AB 1 (с. 97): выбери верные ответы.
steps: B, A, A, A, A.

ab1-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 1 (с. 98). Распредели номера предложений: запланированные действия, намерения, предположения.
steps: Запланированы и подготовлены (Present Progressive): 1, 4, 6. Намерения (going to): 2, 5. Предположения (will): 3, 7.
ab1-s126.answer: Progressive — планы; going to — намерения; will — предположения

ab2-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 2 (с. 98). Заполни пропуски, выбрав правильные варианты.
steps: A, C, A, B, A, C, B, B, A, B, B.
ab2-s126.answer: A, C, A, B, A, C, B, B, A, B, B

ab3-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 3 (с. 99). Заполни пропуски в диалогах.
steps: C, B, A.

ab4-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 4 (с. 99). Напиши, как Том собирается провести каникулы.
steps: We are touring Moscow on Tuesday. Maybe we will visit the Kremlin. We are taking rides in Gorky Park on Wednesday. We are going to see the circus. I think we will have fun.
ab4-s126.answer: Планы Тома: are touring / will visit / are going to

ab5-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 5 (с. 100). Составь 5 вопросов-просьб о совете (Shall I …?).
steps: Shall I buy some food for the dogs for the dog show? Shall I take an umbrella for the fishing competition? Shall I take a camera to the zoo? Shall I wear a costume to the party? Shall I bring a ball to the picnic?

ab6-s126.condition: Unit 7, Consolidation, AB 6 (с. 100). Соотнеси предложения из двух колонок (настоящее / будущее).
steps: A (Pr) — c (F); B (F) — e (Pr); C (Pr) — d (F); D (F) — a (Pr); E (Pr) — b (F).
